abortVisible.description:
AbortVisible allows declarative, data-bound control of the abort button
visibility. When provided, the UI shows the abort button if the value
resolved at `selector` matches `when` (or is truthy if `when` is omitted).
Example:
  abortVisible: { selector: "job.status", when: ["queued", "running"] }

allowAgentSelection.description: Optional composer selector visibility; omitted preserves existing behavior.

dataSourceRef.description: DataSourceRef points to the data source that supplies messages.

on.description: On defines event handlers such as submit, upload

showMic.description: ShowMic toggles the microphone icon in the composer (to the left of Send).

showTools.description: ShowTools toggles the tools picker in the composer.

showUpload.description: ShowUpload controls whether file upload input should be displayed (default true).

tooltips.description: Tooltips optional per-icon tooltip labels for the composer controls.

upload.description: Upload optional configuration for file uploads (endpoint/path/uri).

uploadField.description: UploadField publishes uploaded files to this form field (default: "upload").

exportable.description:
Exportable overrides the default exclusion of action/button columns.
Hidden and selection columns remain excluded regardless of this setting.

columns.description:
Editable-table fields are first-class because authored dashboard.editableTable
metadata must survive YAML -> Go -> JSON without losing explicit false values.

literalGrammar.description: Simple opts into legacy producers that cannot represent embedded quotes.

reportBuilderRef.description:
ReportBuilder intentionally remains open-ended so report-builder-specific
metadata can pass through unchanged from YAML/JSON into the Forge
frontend contract, including explicit chart configuration under
reportBuilder.result.

reportCatalog.description:
ReportCatalog remains open-ended so workspace extensions own their
preset catalog, builder routing, and product-specific labels.

reportOptions.description:
ReportOptions controls the dashboard-level report mode. The older
compact alias is Container.report.

reportRuntime.description:
ReportRuntime embeds an authored report inside an ordinary Forge window.
The report engine validates its spec; dataset bindings reference window sources.

annotations.description:
Annotations are reserved for future timeline overlays; the current JS
runtime ignores this field in v1.

initialFilter.description: InitialFilter seeds UI filter state once; restored/user filters take precedence.

quickFilterSet.description:
QuickFilterSet selects which filterSet should be rendered in the toolbar as quick filters.
Accepts either a string (filterSet.name) or an integer index (0-based).

selectionRetention.description: SelectionRetention "pages" keeps selected rows when only the server page changes.

type.description: string, integer, boolean, object, array, schema …

columnSpan.description:
ColumnSpan defines how many columns this item occupies in a grid layout.
Alternative casings ColSpan/colspan are accepted for backward compatibility.

dialogId.description:
Either DialogId (preferred) or WindowId can be provided. When DialogId
is set, the UI opens a Forge dialog which renders a built-in
Cancel/OK footer. WindowId uses a floating window instead.

footer.description: Optional footer customisation for modal flows: labels/handlers.

requestTrigger.description: RequestTrigger controls typed-value resolution: blur (default) or change.

handler.description: Handler refers to a namespaced action exposed to the UI, e.g. "schedule.onPickOk".

requireSelection.description: When false, OK remains enabled even with no current selection (default true).

prepare.description:
Prepare names an optional async handler that returns the final parameter map
after confirmation and before the writer is invoked.

aggregate.description: Aggregate collects bounded server pages before publishing one complete collection.

mode.description: Mode opts into explicit upstream page/offset/cursor semantics; empty retains legacy behavior.

appearance.description: Appearance "inline" places the formatted value beside a compact native meter.

dataBinding.description: Where to persist the collected answers (same semantics as Chat/Editor)

fields.description:
Fields are rendered in slice order; you can still override per-field
order later via Field.Order.

id.description:
Optional name so other widgets can reference the answers via
{{window.state.<Id>}}

dataSourceRef.description: Optional override to read the selector from another DataSource.

valueColumn.description: ValueColumn explicitly projects scalar values into named rows.

queryDisabledWhen.description: QueryDisabledWhen disables built-in search, paging and sorting controls.

dataSourceRef.description: DataSourceRef points to the data source that supplies terminal entries.

toolbar.description: Optional toolbar to host actions (e.g., run, clear).

path.description: Path relative to endpoint base (defaults to 'upload')

uri.description: Uri destination (prefix) relative to backend file service root

url.description: Absolute URL override. If set, takes precedence over endpoint/path.

parameters.description:
Parameters retains authored window input declarations, including types,
bindings and defaults, without converting them into datasource parameters.

title.description: Title is the original authored display title; namespace is routing metadata.

viewMetadata.description:
ViewMetadata retains the original authored view descriptor as owning-window
metadata. It grants no identity, permissions, or execution authority.

dependencyPins.description:
DependencyPins are runtime-only exact child authority snapshots. The
target proof signs them; authored target declarations must omit them.

executionProof.description:
ExecutionProof is runtime-only original provider provenance. The host
target MAC covers it; it never grants ACL or renews either lease.

emptyOnForbidden.description:
mcp_tool
EmptyOnForbidden opts Fetch reads into an uncached empty result for a
typed upstream 403 only. It never applies to executor/writer operations,
local admission failures, authentication failures or composite backends.

inlineFilters.description: InlineFilters explicitly opt fixtures into request-scoped filtering.

mcpRequest.description:
MCPRequest declares where an authored report query is placed in tool
arguments. Report compilers require an explicit mapping.

ownership.description: Ownership=provider retains execution at the selected resource provider.

pinned.description:
Pinned args — fixed inputs the workspace author sets. On merge with
caller-supplied inputs, Pinned wins on conflict.

producerKind.description: ProducerKind is host-owned classification. Datly requires an exact component pin.

requestMetadata.description:
RequestMetadata names literal top-level logical request keys omitted only
from MCP transport arguments. Cache and admission identity retain these keys.

backend.description: Backend describes the upstream source. Required.

cache.description:
Cache policy. When nil, defaults apply (enabled=true, scope=user,
ttl=30m, refreshPolicy=stale-while-revalidate, maxEntries=5000).
Writers should declare cache: {enabled:false}; datasource semantics are
never inferred from a tool name or HTTP method.

id.description:
ID uniquely identifies this datasource within a workspace. It is
also the URL path segment used by the HTTP endpoint
/v1/api/datasources/{id}/fetch.

responseAliases.description:
ResponseAliases maps logical top-level row keys to exact producer keys.
It applies only to newly fetched rows, preserving original keys/values.

title.description: Title is a human-readable label shown in admin UIs. Optional.

emptyOnForbidden.description: EmptyOnForbidden treats a typed upstream 403 as no rows for an explicitly opted-in legacy lookup.

authContextPath.description:
AuthContextPath receives a server-verified auth.Context value, including
the current narrowed allowedEntities. Never populate it from authored
report input or caller-provided datasource arguments.

completeResult.description:
CompleteResult is a server-owned assertion that the tool returns the
entire result in one call. When false, report callers require an explicit
hasMore signal and an offset page to prove completeness.

hasMorePath.description:
HasMorePath is the exact path in the projected DataInfo object used by
report callers to determine whether another offset page exists.

authorityBinding.description:
AuthorityBinding is recomputed by trusted policy from the current verified
principal, account and authority revision. Client text grants no authority.

providerIdentity.description:
ProviderIdentity is host-declared instance provenance. It is separate
from the logical URI and must match the executing resolver when present.

x-forge-provenance.sourceNote: Generated from committed canonical Forge authored model and Forge-owned public contracts; SHA-256 identifies every parsed source file.
